name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin near $60,840 on 26 Nov, 30% below its high and 20% lower over a month; no de-peg or exchange failure found
state: Bitcoin was near $60,840 early on 26 Nov, 29.8% below its 52-week high of about $86,600, 1.2% higher on the week and 19.9% lower over a month, with a worst day of -2.4% in five sessions (Yahoo Finance). The drawdown is inside the 25–45% Watch band; no major stablecoin de-peg or top-10 exchange failure was found in this run to 26 Nov.
for_you: Crypto prices remain well below their highs and can move sharply; crypto holdings are not covered by the FSCS.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
